name: Question 1
problem: Write the complex number $z=-3-\text{i}$ in the form $r{e}^{\text{i}\theta },$ giving $\theta $ in radians to $3$ decimal places.
worked_solution:
To write $z$ in the form $z=r{\text{e}}^{\text{i}\theta },$ where $r=|z|$ and $\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z),$ we first calculate $r:$

$$
\begin{aligned}r=|z| & =\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(-3)^{2}+(-1)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{10}\end{aligned}
$$

Since $z$ lies in the third quadrant of the complex plane, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z) & =\pi +|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{y}{x})| \\  & =\pi +|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{-1}{-3})| \\  & =\pi +|\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{1}{3})| \\  & ≈3.463.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $r=\sqrt{10}$ and $\theta =3.463$ into $z=r{e}^{\text{i}\theta },$ we get

$$
z=\sqrt{10}\,{\text{e}}^{3.463\,\text{i}}.
$$

Question 1
?

Write the complex number z=−3−i in the form reiθ, giving θ in radians to 3 decimal places.

a
z=10e3.463i
b
z=10e4.281i
c
z=10e3.974i
d
z=25e3.463i
e
z=25e4.281i
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To write z in the form z=reiθ, where r=|z| and θ=arg⁡(z), we first calculate r:

r=|z|=x2+y2=(−3)2+(−1)2=10

Since z lies in the third quadrant of the complex plane, we have θ=arg⁡(z)=π+|arctan⁡(yx)|=π+|arctan⁡(−1−3)|=π+|arctan⁡(13)|≈3.463.

Finally, substituting r=10 and θ=3.463 into z=reiθ, we get z=10e3.463i.
